cap-team.label: KKR win rate, all seasons
cap-team.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
cap-team.query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id IN (6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won FROM matches m WHERE (m.team1_id IN (6) OR m.team2_id IN (6)) AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2026

cap-tab.filters: Captains whose record covers this franchise alone (min. five matches)
